title: River Arevass
wikitext:
The '''River Arevass''' is a [[river]] in [[Silverpine Forest]], running past [[Pyrewood Village]]. It probably originates from the mountains within Silverpine Forest and flows towards or into [[Lordamere Lake]].

On the bridge leading out of the village, the [[night elf]] [[priest]]ess [[Tyrande Whisperwind]], having traveled to [[Lordaeron]] to hunt down [[Illidan Stormrage]], made a stand against the [[Scourge]] in order to save a retreating force of [[Blood elf|blood elves]] led by [[Kael'thas Sunstrider|Prince Kael'thas]]. She succeeded in holding the [[undead]] back, but was swept downriver as the bridge collapsed.
